 People and families who need help paying their heating bills can receive assistance beginning this week through the fall Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP).
 LIHEAP is administered by Audubon Area Community Services (AACS) in its seven-county service area, which includes Daviess, McLean, Ohio, Henderson, Union, Webster and Hancock counties. People who qualify for assistance can receive a credit toward their utility bill.
